SessionStart.command: N=$(command -v node || ls /opt/homebrew/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin/node 2>/dev/null | head -n1); [ -x "$N" ] || { printf '{}\n'; exit 0; }; exec "$N" ./hooks/symea-hook-runner.mjs --platform antigravity --event session-start

PreInvocation.command: N=$(command -v node || ls /opt/homebrew/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin/node 2>/dev/null | head -n1); [ -x "$N" ] || { printf '{}\n'; exit 0; }; exec "$N" ./hooks/symea-hook-runner.mjs --platform antigravity --event prompt-submit

hooks.command: N=$(command -v node || ls /opt/homebrew/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin/node 2>/dev/null | head -n1); [ -x "$N" ] || { printf '{}\n'; exit 0; }; exec "$N" ./hooks/symea-hook-runner.mjs --platform antigravity --event post-connector

Stop.command: N=$(command -v node || ls /opt/homebrew/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin/node 2>/dev/null | head -n1); [ -x "$N" ] || { printf '{"decision":"stop"}\n'; exit 0; }; exec "$N" ./hooks/symea-hook-runner.mjs --platform antigravity --event turn-stop
